app_subtitle: Automated DXVK installer for Windows games
msg_success_body: DXVK installed successfully! Restart your game.
msg_error_arch: Could not detect the executable architecture.
msg_error_dx: Could not detect DirectX version. The game may use Vulkan, OpenGL, or the executable might be packed.
msg_error_network: Could not retrieve the DXVK release list from GitHub. Check your internet connection.
msg_error_extract: Failed to extract the downloaded archive. The Windows tar tool is required.
msg_error_package: The DXVK package does not have the expected folder structure.
msg_error_missing_dlls: This DXVK version does not contain the DLLs required for the detected API ({0}). Please choose another version.
msg_error_d3d12: DXVK does not implement Direct3D 12 and this package does not contain d3d12.dll. D3D12 games require vkd3d-proton instead.
msg_error_copy: Failed to copy the DLLs to the game folder. If the game is in a protected folder, run the script as administrator.
msg_warn_d3d12: Direct3D 12 detected. DXVK does not implement D3D12, so installation will most likely not be possible for this game.
